# Infestations / Infestations / Infestations: New 4 Star Mods & Spawn Map

![Infestations / Infestations / Infestations: New 4 Star Mods & Spawn Map](/uploads/699_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update 05/29/2026]** Challenges added

**Infestation** is a new challenge for high level players. The enemies are ~~significantly~~ stronger and more resilient than most others in the game. A good build and efficient tactics are ~~very~~ helpful here. **Infestation** will be released with Patch 68 on **06/02/2026** alongside Season 25, “Appalachia Under Siege.” We were already able to test on the PTS (Public Test Server) and prepare you for what to expect.

## What is Infestation?

**Infestation** is not an event or activity as you know it before. It is a dynamic system designed for the endgame and for high-level players.

**Infestation** occurs randomly in one of the specified locations in Appalachia (not Skyline Valley and not Burning Springs). The normal opponents are replaced by infestation opponents from a respective faction. These enemies offer a significantly higher challenge than normal enemies.

Official description (help text):

**Infestation**

As you explore Appalachia, you may encounter Infestations - these are time-limited, high-difficulty encounters that occur without warning.

When an enemy faction takes control of an area, the fauna normally found in the area is replaced by powerful and dangerous enemies. These are controlled by a highly challenging faction boss who will drop legendary 4-star rewards when you defeat him.

Infestation events occur only in outdoor areas, turning familiar areas into dangerous, unpredictable ventures.

Infections are not displayed on the map or on the server. You don't realize you're dealing with an infestation until you're in the middle of it, so be careful out there. In Appalachia, nowhere is safe for long.

If you enter a location and there is an infestation nearby, or even if a teammate discovers an infestation, you will see that location marked with a **green circle on the map**. When the infestation is controlled, **another circle in red** will appear on the map. This marks the area where the boss is that can be defeated.

According to the definition in the game data, there is a 5 hour timeout, so if no one has fought and defeated the infestation after 5 hours, it will disappear again. A new location will probably then be occupied. We don't know exactly whether there is a timeout or how often new locations are infested, hopefully Bethesda will give us more information about this. These processes are controlled on the servers and are not easily visible.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-infestation-radius-capture-morgantown.jpg)

## Infestation quick info

- 52 possible locations
- Enemy level scales from 50 to 200
- All opponents in a location are swapped
- Maximum of 5 simultaneous infestations per world
- New spawn: every 10 minutes (if less than 5)
- 5 hour timeout for undetected infestations, then despawn

## Opponents

All enemies in the infestation are significantly stronger than normal enemies. Also mobs. A distinction is made between 3 types of opponents:

- Support
- Mob
-Boss
 - Up to 16870 HP

However, none of the enemies are marked as legendary. The enemies don't have any stars, which doesn't mean you won't get legendary items. More on this below.

*Tip:* Loot all enemies during an infestation!

A location can be infested by one of the following factions:

- Blood Eagle
 - Boss: Blood Eagle Destroyer
- Ghouls
 - Boss: Communist Commissioner
- Cultists
 - Boss: Cultist Prophet
- Greetings
